rows.gloss_cn: 讲究的、一丝不苟的;爱端架子的
rows.gloss_en: fastidious or punctilious; particular about ceremony and dignity
rows.example_en: He was so nice in matters of honour that he overlooked not the slightest affront.
rows.example_cn: 他在名誉之事上极为讲究,一丁点冒犯也不肯放过

rows.gloss_en: to hold or harbour a thought, opinion, or feeling in the mind
rows.modern_en: to receive guests or provide amusement
rows.example_en: She had long entertained grave doubts about the whole scheme.
rows.example_cn: 对整桩计划,她心里早已抱着重重疑虑

rows.gloss_en: to allow of or leave room for something
rows.modern_en: to confess something, or to let someone enter
rows.example_en: The plain wording of the bond admits no other reading.
rows.example_cn: 这契据平实的措辞,不容许有别的解读
